title: Beauty Video Templates for Products | AIVideosUGC
description: Browse beauty video templates, drop in the product you sell, and download a clip in minutes. The frame and the voice are already set, so you can post it.
h1: Beauty Video Templates for Your Product
lead: Browse beauty templates and rebuild any of them with the product you sell, in minutes, without writing a prompt.

steps.d: Upload a clear photo of the product you sell. If the listing needs another side, upload that side next.
Name the side, or describe the scene you want around the product.
Download the clip and post it where you already sell. Add a spoken line or captions first if the ad needs them.

faq.q: What is a beauty video template?
faq.a: A beauty video template is a ready-made ad with the frame, the hook, and the voice already in place. You add the product you sell and download a clip in minutes. You skip filming and a blank file.

faq.q: How does a beauty video template work?
faq.a: The template already has the structure, the line, and the voice. You upload a product photo, check the words, and download a clip that is ready to post.

faq.q: Why use a template instead of filming a creator?
faq.a: A template is faster and costs less than booking a creator. You can post today, try another version, and change the line without waiting on a shoot.

faq.q: Who are these beauty templates for?
faq.a: They are for shops, marketers, and agencies that need beauty ads. A new product or a new ad can start from one photo.

faq.q: Can I use a beauty template if I have never edited video?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear product photo and download a clip in a few steps. You do not need editing practice.

faq.q: Which products fit a beauty video template?
faq.a: They fit beauty, skincare, hair, and most other products a shop sells. Open another card when you want a different kind of ad.

faq.q: Can I bring my own photos and clips?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a product photo, a logo you own, or a short clip you have the rights to use. The ad should still look like your product.

faq.q: Where can I post the clip?
faq.a: The clip can be tall, square, or wide, so it fits TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube. Download it and post it on the channel you already use.

faq.q: Are beauty video templates free to use?
faq.a: No. Each photo spends 24 credits, and a video spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I use the clip in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark. You can run it in paid ads, on your store, and in work you deliver for a client.

faq.q: Why start from a template instead of a blank ad?
faq.a: The size, the frame, and the voice are already chosen. You add your product and your line, then post. You do not have to build the ad from nothing.

faq.q: What if my photo is missing a side I need to show?
faq.a: Upload a photo of that side. The template cannot safely invent a button, a port, or a detail that was not in the picture.
